subject: Scheduling: CIO executive briefing and backup coverage
messages:
From: Lauren Jones <lauren.jones@avery-systems.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.inference.com, marcus_lin@redwood.inference.com
Cc: Carlos Mendez <c.mendez@avery-systems.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Exec briefing request — CIO availability week of Oct 5

Hi Rishi and Marcus,

Thanks for the conversation last week. Our CIO (Anita Rao) is keen to see a short executive briefing and a focused demo that speaks to latency and multi-tenant isolation for a potential dedicated deployment. We're targeting the week of Oct 5. Ideally a 30–45 minute slot that covers: 1) executive overview (10 mins), 2) technical demo (20 mins), and 3) Q&A (10–15 mins).

Can you confirm who from Redwood would lead the exec intro and who will own the technical walkthrough? Also: Anita will be available for an early slot on Oct 6 or Oct 7, but she needs clarity on who will cover procurement questions (enterprise terms/SLA). I've CC'd Carlos from procurement.

Thanks — happy to be flexible on timezones.

Lauren Jones
VP Product, Avery Systems
lauren.jones@avery-systems.com

Attachment: Avery_requirements_snapshot.pdf (pdf)

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.inference.com
To: Lauren Jones <lauren.jones@avery-systems.com>, Carlos Mendez <c.mendez@avery-systems.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.inference.com
Date: 2026-10-01T18:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec briefing request — CIO availability week of Oct 5

Hi Lauren,

Appreciate the clear outline. Marcus will own the technical demo; I can run the executive intro and lead the procurement/SLA conversation at a high level, and we can loop in Laura Bennett (our commercial lead) for any detailed contract questions.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Option A: Tue, Oct 6 — 09:00–09:40 PT (tight but keeps it before most EMEA hours)
- Option B: Wed, Oct 7 — 11:00–11:45 PT (gives Marcus more prep time for deep-dive)

If Anita prefers a single short slot, Option A would be our preference. If you can confirm who from your side will be on the call besides Anita (title + role), we'll finalize the agenda and send a calendar hold.

I've attached a one-page exec agenda we typically use.

Thanks,

— Rishi Malhotra
Head of Field Solutions, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.inference.com
Attachment: Redwood_exec_agenda_v1.pdf (pdf)

From: Lauren Jones <lauren.jones@avery-systems.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.inference.com, marcus_lin@redwood.inference.com
Cc: Carlos Mendez <c.mendez@avery-systems.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec briefing request — CIO availability week of Oct 5

Thanks Rishi — Option A works best for Anita. Please hold Oct 6 09:00–09:40 PT.

Attendees from Avery: Anita Rao (CIO), Lauren Jones (VP Product), Carlos Mendez (Head of Procurement).

Two small asks:
- Can you include a 3–5 minute note on our expected security posture (SOC2 / private deployment options) during the intro?
- Would you be able to record the session for our internal review?

We will send a calendar invite from our side after you confirm.

Best,
Lauren

On attachments: We uploaded a short requirements snapshot in case it helps prep — already attached in the first email.

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.inference.com
To: marcus_lin@redwood.inference.com, laura_bennett@redwood.inference.com
Cc: Lauren Jones <lauren.jones@avery-systems.com>, Carlos Mendez <c.mendez@avery-systems.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Coverage plan for Avery Systems CIO briefing (Oct 6 09:00 PT)

Folks — looping you both to confirm roles for the Oct 6 CIO briefing (09:00–09:40 PT). Thread includes the Avery attendee list and their procurement lead.

High-level plan: 
- 09:00–09:08: Exec intro + product positioning — I will cover business differentiation and the routing/fallback story.
- 09:08–09:28: Technical demo — Marcus will show latency/throughput profiling, routing policies, and a short dedicated vs hosted cost comparison.
- 09:28–09:40: Procurement & security Q&A — Laura, can you cover SLA highlights and how we handle customer-controlled keys/retention? Laura, if you want me to handle the SOC2 intro (3 minutes) and then hand over to you for contract specifics, that works.

Prep items: 
- Marcus: prioritize the demo to show 1) live inference latency on a 4k token prompt, 2) routing failover example, 3) how dedicated capacity is provisioned. Keep the deep quantization bits for a follow-up.
- Laura: bring a short summary of SLA tiers and a sample term sheet we can provide after the call.

I'll send a calendar invite from my account (includes Zoom link) and mark the session to record. Adding a shared Drive link for slides prep: https://drive.google.com/file/d/xyz-agenda

Thanks — please confirm in-line if any changes.

— Rishi
Head of Field Solutions
Redwood Inference
